      "content": "<returncode>0</returncode>\n<output>\n[project]\nname = \"a1-eject\"\nversion = \"0.1.0\"\ndescription = \"Bambu Lab A1 N-loop auto-eject web app (Factorian Designs method)\"\nrequires-python = \">=3.13\"\ndependencies = [\n    \"fastapi>=0.115\",\n    \"uvicorn[standard]>=0.30\",\n    \"python-multipart>=0.0.9\",\n]\n\n[dependency-groups]\ndev = [\n    \"pytest>=8.0\",\n    \"httpx>=0.27\",\n]\n\n[build-system]\nrequires = [\"hatchling\"]\nbuild-backend = \"hatchling.build\"\n\n[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]\npackages = [\"autoeject\", \"app\"]\n\n[tool.pytest.ini_options]\ntestpaths = [\"tests\"]\naddopts = \"-q\"\n=== README ===\n# Bambu Lab A1 Auto-Eject\n\nA small web app for the **Bambu Lab A1 (256 x 256 mm bed, A1 only)**: upload one\npart, choose how many times it should print (N), and get back a native\n`.gcode.3mf` that prints the part N times, pushing each finished part off the bed\nbetween iterations (Factorian Designs method).\n\n* `autoeject/` - pure-Python core (STL checks, G-code end block, .gcode.3mf loop, motion sim).\n* `app/` - FastAPI app + single static page (`app/static/index.html`, no build step).\n* `profiles/a1_end.gcode` - the eject template (BambuStudio placeholders are evaluated before anything is written).\n* `fixtures/` - `cube.stl` and a real Bambu Studio A1 export `real_a1.gcode.3mf` (20.08 mm part, 72 layers).\n\n## API\n\n| Method | Path | In | Out |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| POST | `/api/check` | multipart STL (`file`) | JSON `{verdict, reasons, metrics}` |\n| POST | `/api/slice` | multipart STL (`file`), `n`, `bed_heat_temp`, `bed_heat_hold`, `bed_cool_temp`, `bed_cool_hold`, `cycle_count` | `.gcode.3mf` |\n| POST | `/api/fallback` | multipart `.gcode.3mf` (`file`), same eject params | `.gcode.3mf` |\n\nA `fail` verdict blocks the download (HTTP 400 with the reasons); `warn` is\nreported in the `X-Eject-Verdict` / `X-Eject-Reasons` response headers and never\nblocks. `X-Eject-Sim` carries the end-block simulation (boxes, path, collision /\nmissed-push flags) used by the browser preview. There is no printer parameter\nanywhere: the machine profile is always `Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle`.\n\n## Run locally\n\n```bash\n# 1. install (Python 3.13 + uv)\nuv sync\n\n# 2. run the app\nuv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000\n# open http://127.0.0.1:8000\n```\n\nSlicing uses the Bambu Studio CLI, so point the app at it:\n\n```bash\nexport BAMBU_CLI=/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/MacOS/BambuStudio\nexport BAMBU_PROFILES=/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/Resources/profiles\n```\n\n`/api/fallback` and `/api/check` work without the CLI; `/api/slice` answers\n`503` with a clear message when `BAMBU_CLI` is missing or not runnable.\n\n### Exporting a sliced file from Bambu Studio\n\nTo use the fallback path (recommended: slice in the GUI with your own A1\nsettings, then let the app swap the stock end block for the eject block):\n\n1. Open Bambu Studio, select the **Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle** printer, load your\n   part and slice it.\n2. Menu **File -> Export -> Export plate sliced file** (this writes a\n   `*.gcode.3mf`, not a plain `.gcode`).\n3. Upload that `.gcode.3mf` on the page, set N and the heat/cool params, and\n   download the patched file.\n\n### Tests\n\n```bash\nuv run pytest -q\n```\n\nThe tests never need a printer, the network, or the real Bambu Studio binary:\nthe slicer CLI is faked, and every module that reads or writes `.gcode.3mf` is\nexercised against `fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf`.\n\n## Deploy\n\n`railway.toml` starts `uv run --no-dev uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`\n(health check `/`). `Dockerfile` is provided for images where a pinned\nBambu Studio CLI is installed; set `BAMBU_CLI` / `BAMBU_PROFILES` accordingly.\n=== autoeject/__init__ ===\n\"\"\"Pure-Python core for the Bambu Lab A1 auto-eject web app (A1 only).\"\"\"\nfrom .check import check\nfrom .loop import loop_3mf\nfrom .simulate import parse_end_block, simulate_end_block\nfrom .slicer import (\n    DEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS,\n    EndBlockError,\n    PlaceholderError,\n    SlicerUnavailable,\n    build_eject_values,\n    build_end_block,\n    evaluate_end_block,\n    header_max_z,\n    inject_end_block,\n    read_gcode_3mf,\n    render_eject_block,\n    replace_machine_end_span,\n    slice_stl,\n)\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"check\",\n    \"loop_3mf\",\n    \"parse_end_block\",\n    \"simulate_end_block\",\n    \"DEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS\",\n    \"EndBlockError\",\n    \"PlaceholderError\",\n    \"SlicerUnavailable\",\n    \"build_eject_values\",\n    \"build_end_block\",\n    \"evaluate_end_block\",\n    \"header_max_z\",\n    \"inject_end_block\",\n    \"read_gcode_3mf\",\n    \"render_eject_block\",\n    \"replace_machine_end_span\",\n    \"slice_stl\",\n]\n</output>\n<budget> Step 2 of 50 (48 left). $0.00 of $3.00 spent. Submit your final output before you run out; work cut off by a limit is lost.\n</budget>",

      "content": "<returncode>0</returncode>\n<output>\n; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\n; AutoEject end block - Bambu Lab A1 (Factorian Designs method)\n; max_layer_z = {max_layer_z}\nG90\nG1 E-2 F1800\n{repeat cycle_count}\nM140 S{bed_heat_temp}\nM190 S{bed_heat_temp}\nG4 P{bed_heat_hold_ms}\nM140 S{bed_cool_temp}\nM190 S{bed_cool_temp}\nG4 P{bed_cool_hold_ms}\n{endrepeat}\n{if gantry_push}\n; gantry push at {gantry_push_z} mm\nG1 Z{gantry_push_z} F600\nG1 Y-0.5 F{push_feed}\n{else}\n; nozzle push fallback at {nozzle_push_z} mm\nG1 Z{nozzle_push_z} F600\nG1 Y-0.5 F{push_feed}\n{endif}\nG1 Y0 F{push_feed}\nM104 S0\nM140 S0\n; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\n=== check.py ===\n\"\"\"Ejectability pre-check for the Bambu Lab A1 (256 x 256 mm bed, A1 only).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom .stl import base_contact_area, bounds\n\nBED_X = 256.0\nBED_Y = 256.0\nEDGE_MARGIN = 20.0\nMIN_BASE_AREA = 100.0\nMAX_TIPOVER = 5.0\nHEIGHT_WARN = 32.0\n\n\ndef _as_bytes(data) -> bytes:\n    if isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):\n        return bytes(data)\n    if isinstance(data, (str, Path)):\n        return Path(data).read_bytes()\n    raise TypeError(\"check() expects STL bytes or a path\")\n\n\ndef check(stl) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Return ``{verdict, reason, reasons, metrics}`` for an STL.\n\n    verdict is ``\"fail\"`` if any hard rule is broken, else ``\"warn\"`` if any\n    advisory rule fired, else ``\"pass\"``.\n    \"\"\"\n    data = _as_bytes(stl)\n    box = bounds(data)\n    area = base_contact_area(data)\n    height = box[\"size\"][2]\n    minx, miny, _ = box[\"min\"]\n    maxx, maxy, _ = box[\"max\"]\n    base_width = min(box[\"size\"][0], box[\"size\"][1])\n    tip_over = (height / base_width) if base_width > 0 else float(\"inf\")\n    near_edge = (\n        minx < EDGE_MARGIN\n        or miny < EDGE_MARGIN\n        or maxx > BED_X - EDGE_MARGIN\n        or maxy > BED_Y - EDGE_MARGIN\n    )\n\n    reasons = []\n    if near_edge:\n        reasons.append(\"footprint within 20 mm of the bed edge\")\n    if area < MIN_BASE_AREA:\n        reasons.append(f\"base contact area {area:.1f} mm^2 below {MIN_BASE_AREA:g} mm^2\")\n    if tip_over > MAX_TIPOVER:\n        reasons.append(f\"tip-over ratio {tip_over:.2f} above {MAX_TIPOVER:g}\")\n    if height < HEIGHT_WARN:\n        reasons.append(\n            f\"max layer z {height:.2f} mm below gantry-push threshold {HEIGHT_WARN:g} mm \"\n            \"(nozzle push fallback)\"\n        )\n\n    if any(r.startswith((\"footprint\", \"base contact\", \"tip-over\")) for r in reasons):\n        verdict = \"fail\"\n    elif reasons:\n        verdict = \"warn\"\n    else:\n        verdict = \"pass\"\n\n    metrics = {\n        \"height_mm\": round(height, 4),\n        \"base_area_mm2\": round(area, 4),\n        \"base_width_mm\": round(base_width, 4),\n        \"tip_over_ratio\": round(tip_over, 4),\n        \"bbox_min\": [round(v, 4) for v in box[\"min\"]],\n        \"bbox_max\": [round(v, 4) for v in box[\"max\"]],\n    }\n    return {\n        \"verdict\": verdict,\n        \"reason\": reasons[0] if reasons else \"\",\n        \"reasons\": reasons,\n        \"metrics\": metrics,\n    }\n</output>\n<budget> Step 6 of 50 (44 left). $0.00 of $3.00 spent.             "arguments": "{\"command\": \"cd /private/var/folders/9q/22sbzpn16rng7bfbch93n2nr0000gn/T/promptmap-coding-agent-b6c7f4bffe9f9f37/3_b_core && cat >> README.md <<'MDEOF'\\n\\n## OrcaSlicer plugin (v2)\\n\\n`orca_plugin/` is an OrcaSlicer 2.5 plugin of type `SlicingPipeline`. It appends\\nthe same v1 eject block to the G-code OrcaSlicer exports for a **Bambu Lab A1**\\n(A1 only). It never reimplements eject logic: the v1 `autoeject` package is\\nvendored byte-for-byte under `orca_plugin/_autoeject/` and exposed as\\n`orca_plugin.autoeject`, with a thin signature adapter for the plain working\\nG-code file that the plugin hook provides.\\n\\n```\\norca_plugin/\\n  __init__.py        # PEP 723 script header + [tool.orcaslicer.plugin] manifest\\n  plugin.py          # A1AutoEjectCapability (SlicingPipeline.execute + config UI)\\n  autoeject.py       # signature adapter over the vendored v1 package\\n  _autoeject/        # vendored v1 autoeject (unchanged)\\n  a1_end.gcode       # bundled copy of profiles/a1_end.gcode\\n```\\n\\n### Install\\n\\nCopy the whole `orca_plugin/` folder into OrcaSlicer's plugin directory and\\nrestart OrcaSlicer. The PEP 723 header at the top of `orca_plugin/__init__.py`\\ndeclares `requires-python = \\\">=3.12\\\"`, no dependencies and the\\n`[tool.orcaslicer.plugin]` manifest, so the folder installs as-is (no `pip\\ninstall`, no web-app checkout needed).\\n\\n### Use\\n\\nThe capability implements `orca.slicing.SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase.execute`.\\nAt `orca.slicing.Step.psGCodePostProcess` it reads `ctx.gcode_path`, builds the\\neject block from its config and writes the working G-code file back in place.\\nIt also exposes the config UI (`has_config_ui`, `get_config_ui`,\\n`get_default_config`, `get_config`, `save_config`). Defaults match v1:\\n\\n| Param | Default | Editable |\\n| --- | --- | --- |\\n| `bed_heat_temp` | 60 | yes |\\n| `bed_heat_hold` | 60 | yes |\\n| `bed_cool_temp` | 25 | yes |\\n| `bed_cool_hold` | 120 | yes |\\n| `cycle_count` | 3 | yes |\\n| `gantry_push_z` | 50 | no (read-only) |\\n| `nozzle_push_z` | 1 | no (read-only) |\\n| `push_feed` | 6000 | no (read-only) |\\n| `max_layer_z_threshold` | 41 | no (read-only) |\\n\\n`execute(ctx, n=...)` optionally repeats the executable block `n` times by\\ndelegating to the vendored `autoeject.loop_3mf` (the web app still owns the\\nnormal N loop in `/api/slice`).\\n\\n### Known limits / open questions\\n\\nThe v2 spec's open questions are stubbed with\\n`NotImplementedError(\\\"open question: ...\\\")` rather than invented Orca API\\ncalls:\\n\\n* `check_model` - no documented API to obtain STL bytes for `autoeject.check`.\\n* `replace_stock_end_gcode` - no documented accessor for the printer's existing\\n  end G-code; the plugin only appends a new eject block.\\n* `repeat_print` - no documented hook/capability for re-queuing a finished job.\\n* `handle_gcode_3mf_fallback` - no documented `.gcode.3mf` support in the\\n  `SlicingPipeline` hook; v1 `/api/fallback` stays in the web app.\\n* `start_printer_job` - `PrinterAgentBase` print calls and their lifecycle\\n  interaction are undocumented.\\n\\nAlso undocumented: whether `psGCodePostProcess` runs for a Bambu Lab A1 network\\nupload and how many times it runs. The push coordinates/safe Z/feed are the v1\\ndefaults (`gantry_push_z=50`, `push_feed=6000`) and still need hardware\\nvalidation.\\n\\n### Plugin tests\\n\\n```bash\\nuv run pytest tests/test_orca_plugin.py -q\\n```\\n\\nThey use a fake `orca` module matching the spec signatures; no OrcaSlicer,\\nprinter or network is required. `orca_plugin.autoeject` is tested against\\n`fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf`, and `execute(..., n=3)` on that fixture produces\\nthree push moves with a recomputed plate md5.\\nMDEOF\\necho \\\"README updated\\\" && tail -5 README.md\"}",

  "changes": {
    "README.md": "# Bambu Lab A1 Auto-Eject\n\nA small web app for the **Bambu Lab A1 (256 x 256 mm bed, A1 only)**: upload one\npart, choose how many times it should print (N), and get back a native\n`.gcode.3mf` that prints the part N times, pushing each finished part off the bed\nbetween iterations (Factorian Designs method).\n\n* `autoeject/` - pure-Python core (STL checks, G-code end block, .gcode.3mf loop, motion sim).\n* `app/` - FastAPI app + single static page (`app/static/index.html`, no build step).\n* `profiles/a1_end.gcode` - the eject template (BambuStudio placeholders are evaluated before anything is written).\n* `fixtures/` - `cube.stl` and a real Bambu Studio A1 export `real_a1.gcode.3mf` (20.08 mm part, 72 layers).\n\n## API\n\n| Method | Path | In | Out |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| POST | `/api/check` | multipart STL (`file`) | JSON `{verdict, reasons, metrics}` |\n| POST | `/api/slice` | multipart STL (`file`), `n`, `bed_heat_temp`, `bed_heat_hold`, `bed_cool_temp`, `bed_cool_hold`, `cycle_count` | `.gcode.3mf` |\n| POST | `/api/fallback` | multipart `.gcode.3mf` (`file`), same eject params | `.gcode.3mf` |\n\nA `fail` verdict blocks the download (HTTP 400 with the reasons); `warn` is\nreported in the `X-Eject-Verdict` / `X-Eject-Reasons` response headers and never\nblocks. `X-Eject-Sim` carries the end-block simulation (boxes, path, collision /\nmissed-push flags) used by the browser preview. There is no printer parameter\nanywhere: the machine profile is always `Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle`.\n\n## Run locally\n\n```bash\n# 1. install (Python 3.13 + uv)\nuv sync\n\n# 2. run the app\nuv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000\n# open http://127.0.0.1:8000\n```\n\nSlicing uses the Bambu Studio CLI, so point the app at it:\n\n```bash\nexport BAMBU_CLI=/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/MacOS/BambuStudio\nexport BAMBU_PROFILES=/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/Resources/profiles\n```\n\n`/api/fallback` and `/api/check` work without the CLI; `/api/slice` answers\n`503` with a clear message when `BAMBU_CLI` is missing or not runnable.\n\n### Exporting a sliced file from Bambu Studio\n\nTo use the fallback path (recommended: slice in the GUI with your own A1\nsettings, then let the app swap the stock end block for the eject block):\n\n1. Open Bambu Studio, select the **Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle** printer, load your\n   part and slice it.\n2. Menu **File -> Export -> Export plate sliced file** (this writes a\n   `*.gcode.3mf`, not a plain `.gcode`).\n3. Upload that `.gcode.3mf` on the page, set N and the heat/cool params, and\n   download the patched file.\n\n### Tests\n\n```bash\nuv run pytest -q\n```\n\nThe tests never need a printer, the network, or the real Bambu Studio binary:\nthe slicer CLI is faked, and every module that reads or writes `.gcode.3mf` is\nexercised against `fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf`.\n\n## Deploy\n\n`railway.toml` starts `uv run --no-dev uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`\n(health check `/`). `Dockerfile` is provided for images where a pinned\nBambu Studio CLI is installed; set `BAMBU_CLI` / `BAMBU_PROFILES` accordingly.\n\n## OrcaSlicer plugin (v2)\n\n`orca_plugin/` is an OrcaSlicer 2.5 plugin of type `SlicingPipeline`. It appends\nthe same v1 eject block to the G-code OrcaSlicer exports for a **Bambu Lab A1**\n(A1 only). It never reimplements eject logic: the v1 `autoeject` package is\nvendored byte-for-byte under `orca_plugin/_autoeject/` and exposed as\n`orca_plugin.autoeject`, with a thin signature adapter for the plain working\nG-code file that the plugin hook provides.\n\n```\norca_plugin/\n  __init__.py        # PEP 723 script header + [tool.orcaslicer.plugin] manifest\n  plugin.py          # A1AutoEjectCapability (SlicingPipeline.execute + config UI)\n  autoeject.py       # signature adapter over the vendored v1 package\n  _autoeject/        # vendored v1 autoeject (unchanged)\n  a1_end.gcode       # bundled copy of profiles/a1_end.gcode\n```\n\n### Install\n\nCopy the whole `orca_plugin/` folder into OrcaSlicer's plugin directory and\nrestart OrcaSlicer. The PEP 723 header at the top of `orca_plugin/__init__.py`\ndeclares `requires-python = \">=3.12\"`, no dependencies and the\n`[tool.orcaslicer.plugin]` manifest, so the folder installs as-is (no `pip\ninstall`, no web-app checkout needed).\n\n### Use\n\nThe capability implements `orca.slicing.SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase.execute`.\nAt `orca.slicing.Step.psGCodePostProcess` it reads `ctx.gcode_path`, builds the\neject block from its config and writes the working G-code file back in place.\nIt also exposes the config UI (`has_config_ui`, `get_config_ui`,\n`get_default_config`, `get_config`, `save_config`). Defaults match v1:\n\n| Param | Default | Editable |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `bed_heat_temp` | 60 | yes |\n| `bed_heat_hold` | 60 | yes |\n| `bed_cool_temp` | 25 | yes |\n| `bed_cool_hold` | 120 | yes |\n| `cycle_count` | 3 | yes |\n| `gantry_push_z` | 50 | no (read-only) |\n| `nozzle_push_z` | 1 | no (read-only) |\n| `push_feed` | 6000 | no (read-only) |\n| `max_layer_z_threshold` | 41 | no (read-only) |\n\n`execute(ctx, n=...)` optionally repeats the executable block `n` times by\ndelegating to the vendored `autoeject.loop_3mf` (the web app still owns the\nnormal N loop in `/api/slice`).\n\n### Known limits / open questions\n\nThe v2 spec's open questions are stubbed with\n`NotImplementedError(\"open question: ...\")` rather than invented Orca API\ncalls:\n\n* `check_model` - no documented API to obtain STL bytes for `autoeject.check`.\n* `replace_stock_end_gcode` - no documented accessor for the printer's existing\n  end G-code; the plugin only appends a new eject block.\n* `repeat_print` - no documented hook/capability for re-queuing a finished job.\n* `handle_gcode_3mf_fallback` - no documented `.gcode.3mf` support in the\n  `SlicingPipeline` hook; v1 `/api/fallback` stays in the web app.\n* `start_printer_job` - `PrinterAgentBase` print calls and their lifecycle\n  interaction are undocumented.\n\nAlso undocumented: whether `psGCodePostProcess` runs for a Bambu Lab A1 network\nupload and how many times it runs. The push coordinates/safe Z/feed are the v1\ndefaults (`gantry_push_z=50`, `push_feed=6000`) and still need hardware\nvalidation.\n\n### Plugin tests\n\n```bash\nuv run pytest tests/test_orca_plugin.py -q\n```\n\nThey use a fake `orca` module matching the spec signatures; no OrcaSlicer,\nprinter or network is required. `orca_plugin.autoeject` is tested against\n`fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf`, and `execute(..., n=3)` on that fixture produces\nthree push moves with a recomputed plate md5.\n",
    "orca_plugin/__init__.py": "# /// script\n# requires-python = \">=3.12\"\n# dependencies = []\n#\n# [tool.orcaslicer.plugin]\n# name = \"A1 AutoEject\"\n# description = \"Appends the v1 autoeject end block to exported A1 G-code.\"\n# author = \"A1 AutoEject contributors\"\n# version = \"2.0.0\"\n# ///\n\"\"\"OrcaSlicer 2.5 plugin: Bambu Lab A1 (A1 only) auto-eject end block.\n\nInstall the ``orca_plugin/`` folder into OrcaSlicer's plugin directory as-is.\nThe v1 ``autoeject`` package is vendored under :mod:`orca_plugin._autoeject`\nand exposed as :mod:`orca_plugin.autoeject` (a thin signature adapter, see its\ndocstring).  Only the ``SlicingPipeline`` plugin type and its ``execute`` hook\nnamed in the v2 spec are used.\n\"\"\"\nfrom . import autoeject\nfrom .plugin import (\n    PLUGIN_NAME,\n    PLUGIN_TYPE,\n    PLUGIN_VERSION,\n    A1AutoEjectCapability,\n    register,\n)\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"autoeject\",\n    \"A1AutoEjectCapability\",\n    \"PLUGIN_NAME\",\n    \"PLUGIN_TYPE\",\n    \"PLUGIN_VERSION\",\n    \"register\",\n]\n\n__version__ = PLUGIN_VERSION\n",
    "orca_plugin/_autoeject/__init__.py": "\"\"\"Pure-Python core for the Bambu Lab A1 auto-eject web app (A1 only).\"\"\"\nfrom .check import check\nfrom .loop import loop_3mf\nfrom .simulate import parse_end_block, simulate_end_block\nfrom .slicer import (\n    DEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS,\n    EndBlockError,\n    PlaceholderError,\n    SlicerUnavailable,\n    build_eject_values,\n    build_end_block,\n    evaluate_end_block,\n    header_max_z,\n    inject_end_block,\n    read_gcode_3mf,\n    render_eject_block,\n    replace_machine_end_span,\n    slice_stl,\n)\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"check\",\n    \"loop_3mf\",\n    \"parse_end_block\",\n    \"simulate_end_block\",\n    \"DEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS\",\n    \"EndBlockError\",\n    \"PlaceholderError\",\n    \"SlicerUnavailable\",\n    \"build_eject_values\",\n    \"build_end_block\",\n    \"evaluate_end_block\",\n    \"header_max_z\",\n    \"inject_end_block\",\n    \"read_gcode_3mf\",\n    \"render_eject_block\",\n    \"replace_machine_end_span\",\n    \"slice_stl\",\n]\n",
    "orca_plugin/_autoeject/check.py": "\"\"\"Ejectability pre-check for the Bambu Lab A1 (256 x 256 mm bed, A1 only).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom .stl import base_contact_area, bounds\n\nBED_X = 256.0\nBED_Y = 256.0\nEDGE_MARGIN = 20.0\nMIN_BASE_AREA = 100.0\nMAX_TIPOVER = 5.0\nHEIGHT_WARN = 32.0\n\n\ndef _as_bytes(data) -> bytes:\n    if isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):\n        return bytes(data)\n    if isinstance(data, (str, Path)):\n        return Path(data).read_bytes()\n    raise TypeError(\"check() expects STL bytes or a path\")\n\n\ndef check(stl) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Return ``{verdict, reason, reasons, metrics}`` for an STL.\n\n    verdict is ``\"fail\"`` if any hard rule is broken, else ``\"warn\"`` if any\n    advisory rule fired, else ``\"pass\"``.\n    \"\"\"\n    data = _as_bytes(stl)\n    box = bounds(data)\n    area = base_contact_area(data)\n    height = box[\"size\"][2]\n    minx, miny, _ = box[\"min\"]\n    maxx, maxy, _ = box[\"max\"]\n    base_width = min(box[\"size\"][0], box[\"size\"][1])\n    tip_over = (height / base_width) if base_width > 0 else float(\"inf\")\n    near_edge = (\n        minx < EDGE_MARGIN\n        or miny < EDGE_MARGIN\n        or maxx > BED_X - EDGE_MARGIN\n        or maxy > BED_Y - EDGE_MARGIN\n    )\n\n    reasons = []\n    if near_edge:\n        reasons.append(\"footprint within 20 mm of the bed edge\")\n    if area < MIN_BASE_AREA:\n        reasons.append(f\"base contact area {area:.1f} mm^2 below {MIN_BASE_AREA:g} mm^2\")\n    if tip_over > MAX_TIPOVER:\n        reasons.append(f\"tip-over ratio {tip_over:.2f} above {MAX_TIPOVER:g}\")\n    if height < HEIGHT_WARN:\n        reasons.append(\n            f\"max layer z {height:.2f} mm below gantry-push threshold {HEIGHT_WARN:g} mm \"\n            \"(nozzle push fallback)\"\n        )\n\n    if any(r.startswith((\"footprint\", \"base contact\", \"tip-over\")) for r in reasons):\n        verdict = \"fail\"\n    elif reasons:\n        verdict = \"warn\"\n    else:\n        verdict = \"pass\"\n\n    metrics = {\n        \"height_mm\": round(height, 4),\n        \"base_area_mm2\": round(area, 4),\n        \"base_width_mm\": round(base_width, 4),\n        \"tip_over_ratio\": round(tip_over, 4),\n        \"bbox_min\": [round(v, 4) for v in box[\"min\"]],\n        \"bbox_max\": [round(v, 4) for v in box[\"max\"]],\n    }\n    return {\n        \"verdict\": verdict,\n        \"reason\": reasons[0] if reasons else \"\",\n        \"reasons\": reasons,\n        \"metrics\": metrics,\n    }\n",
    "orca_plugin/_autoeject/loop.py": "\"\"\"Repeat the executable block N times inside a .gcode.3mf (Factorian loop).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom .slicer import (\n    _check_no_placeholders,\n    _find_marker,\n    _replace_plate,\n    read_gcode_3mf,\n    EndBlockError,\n)\n\n\ndef loop_3mf(gcode_3mf_bytes: bytes, n: int) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Return ``gcode_3mf_bytes`` with its executable block repeated ``n`` times.\n\n    The span between ``; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START`` and\n    ``; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END`` is duplicated, the plate md5 is recomputed and\n    unevaluated placeholders in non-comment lines are rejected.\n    \"\"\"\n    n = int(n)\n    if n < 1:\n        raise ValueError(\"n must be >= 1\")\n    gcode = read_gcode_3mf(gcode_3mf_bytes)\n\n    start = _find_marker(gcode, \"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START\")\n    if not start:\n        raise EndBlockError(\"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START not found\")\n    end = _find_marker(gcode, \"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\", start.end())\n    if not end:\n        raise EndBlockError(\"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END not found\")\n    end_abs = start.end() + end.start()\n\n    content = gcode[start.end():end_abs]\n    if not content.endswith(\"\\n\"):\n        content += \"\\n\"\n    new_gcode = gcode[:start.end()] + content * n + gcode[end_abs:]\n\n    _check_no_placeholders(new_gcode)\n    return _replace_plate(gcode_3mf_bytes, new_gcode)\n",
    "orca_plugin/_autoeject/simulate.py": "\"\"\"Minimal end-block motion simulation (bounding boxes + collision checks).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nBED_SIZE = 256.0\n_MOVE_RE = re.compile(r\"([XYZ])(-?[0-9.]+)\")\n\n\ndef _iter_moves(gcode: str):\n    x = y = z = 0.0\n    for raw in gcode.splitlines():\n        line = raw.split(\";\", 1)[0].strip()\n        if not line.startswith(\"G1\"):\n            continue\n        nx, ny, nz = x, y, z\n        for axis, value in _MOVE_RE.findall(line):\n            if axis == \"X\":\n                nx = float(value)\n            elif axis == \"Y\":\n                ny = float(value)\n            else:\n                nz = float(value)\n        yield (x, y, z, nx, ny, nz)\n        x, y, z = nx, ny, nz\n\n\ndef _box(points):\n    xs = [p[0] for p in points]\n    ys = [p[1] for p in points]\n    zs = [p[2] for p in points]\n    return {\"min\": (min(xs), min(ys), min(zs)), \"max\": (max(xs), max(ys), max(zs))}\n\n\ndef _marker_span(gcode: str):\n    m = re.search(r\"^.*MACHINE_END_GCODE_START.*$\", gcode, re.M)\n    if not m:\n        raise ValueError(\"MACHINE_END_GCODE_START not found\")\n    tail = re.search(r\"^.*EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END.*$\", gcode[m.end():], re.M)\n    end = m.end() + tail.start() if tail else len(gcode)\n    return m.start(), end\n\n\ndef parse_end_block(gcode: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Return toolhead/gantry/bed/STL bounding boxes for the end block.\"\"\"\n    start, end = _marker_span(gcode)\n    before = gcode[:start]\n    end_block = gcode[start:end]\n\n    print_pts = [(nx, ny, nz) for (_x, _y, _z, nx, ny, nz) in _iter_moves(before)]\n    if not print_pts:\n        print_pts = [(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]\n    stl_box = _box(print_pts)\n    stl_top = stl_box[\"max\"][2]\n\n    end_pts = [(x, y, z) for (x, y, z, _nx, _ny, _nz) in _iter_moves(end_block)]\n    end_pts += [(nx, ny, nz) for (_x, _y, _z, nx, ny, nz) in _iter_moves(end_block)]\n    if not end_pts:\n        end_pts = [(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]\n    toolhead = _box(end_pts)\n    gantry_z = toolhead[\"max\"][2]\n    gantry = {\"min\": (0.0, 0.0, gantry_z), \"max\": (BED_SIZE, BED_SIZE, gantry_z)}\n    bed = {\"min\": (0.0, 0.0, 0.0), \"max\": (BED_SIZE, BED_SIZE, 0.2)}\n    return {\n        \"toolhead\": toolhead,\n        \"gantry\": gantry,\n        \"bed\": bed,\n        \"stl\": stl_box,\n        \"stl_top_z\": stl_top,\n    }\n\n\ndef simulate_end_block(gcode: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Flag collisions (X/Y move into the part below its top) and missed pushes.\"\"\"\n    boxes = parse_end_block(gcode)\n    start, end = _marker_span(gcode)\n    end_block = gcode[start:end]\n    stl = boxes[\"stl\"]\n    stl_top = boxes[\"stl_top_z\"]\n    (sx0, sy0, _), (sx1, sy1, _) = stl[\"min\"], stl[\"max\"]\n\n    collision = False\n    lifted = False\n    pushed = False\n    path = []\n    for (x, y, z, nx, ny, nz) in _iter_moves(end_block):\n        path.append([round(nx, 3), round(ny, 3), round(nz, 3)])\n        # The toolhead counts as lifted once it is at/above the part top: the\n        # gantry push clears it, and the nozzle push fallback (used for parts\n        # below the gantry threshold) reaches the top of a short part.\n        if nz > stl_top:\n            lifted = True\n        if lifted and (abs(nx - x) > 0.01 or abs(ny - y) > 0.01):\n            pushed = True\n        if nz < stl_top - 0.5 and (sx0 <= nx <= sx1) and (sy0 <= ny <= sy1):\n            if abs(nx - x) > 0.01 or abs(ny - y) > 0.01:\n                collision = True\n\n    return {\n        \"collision\": collision,\n        \"missed_push\": not (lifted and pushed),\n        \"boxes\": boxes,\n        \"path\": path,\n    }\n",
    "orca_plugin/_autoeject/slicer.py": "\"\"\"BambuStudio A1 slicing + .gcode.3mf post-processing.\n\nA1 only.  There is deliberately no printer parameter anywhere: the machine\nprofile name is a module constant (``Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle``).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport tempfile\nimport zipfile\nfrom io import BytesIO\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nPLATE_GCODE = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode\"\nPLATE_MD5 = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5\"\nMACHINE_PROFILE_NAME = \"Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle\"\n\n# v1 defaults from the binding spec (A1 only).\nDEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS = {\n    \"bed_heat_temp\": 60,\n    \"bed_heat_hold\": 60,          # seconds\n    \"bed_cool_temp\": 25,\n    \"bed_cool_hold\": 120,         # seconds\n    \"cycle_count\": 3,\n    \"gantry_push_z\": 50,          # mm\n    \"nozzle_push_z\": 1,           # mm\n    \"push_feed\": 6000,            # mm/min\n    \"max_layer_z_threshold\": 41,  # mm\n}\n\n\nclass SlicerUnavailable(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"BambuStudio CLI missing/failed; the API turns this into HTTP 503.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass EndBlockError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The end block could not be located/replaced; API turns this into 400.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass PlaceholderError(EndBlockError):\n    \"\"\"Unevaluated ``{...}`` survived in a non-comment G-code line.\"\"\"\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Tiny template engine for profiles/a1_end.gcode\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r\"\\{([^{}]*)\\}\")\n_COMPARE_RE = re.compile(r\"^(.+?)\\s*(==|!=|>=|<=|>|<)\\s*(.+)$\")\n\n\ndef _stringify(value) -> str:\n    if isinstance(value, float):\n        return str(int(value)) if value.is_integer() else (\"%g\" % value)\n    return str(value)\n\n\ndef _atom(token, values):\n    token = token.strip()\n    if token in values:\n        return values[token]\n    if len(token) >= 2 and token[0] == token[-1] and token[0] in \"\\\"'\":\n        return token[1:-1]\n    try:\n        num = float(token)\n        return int(num) if num.is_integer() else num\n    except ValueError:\n        return token\n\n\ndef _truthy(value) -> bool:\n    if isinstance(value, str):\n        return value.strip().lower() not in (\"\", \"0\", \"false\", \"no\", \"off\")\n    return bool(value)\n\n\ndef _eval_expr(expr, values) -> bool:\n    m = _COMPARE_RE.match(expr.strip())\n    if m:\n        left = _atom(m.group(1), values)\n        right = _atom(m.group(3), values)\n        op = m.group(2)\n        try:\n            if op == \"==\":\n                return left == right\n            if op == \"!=\":\n                return left != right\n            if op == \">=\":\n                return float(left) >= float(right)\n            if op == \"<=\":\n                return float(left) <= float(right)\n            if op == \">\":\n                return float(left) > float(right)\n            if op == \"<\":\n                return float(left) < float(right)\n        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n            return False\n    return _truthy(_atom(expr, values))\n\n\ndef _tokenize(text: str):\n    tokens = []\n    pos = 0\n    for m in _TOKEN_RE.finditer(text):\n        if m.start() > pos:\n            tokens.append((\"text\", text[pos:m.start()]))\n        expr = m.group(1).strip()\n        if expr.startswith(\"if \") or expr.startswith(\"if\\t\"):\n            tokens.append((\"if\", expr[2:].strip()))\n        elif expr == \"else\":\n            tokens.append((\"else\", \"\"))\n        elif expr == \"endif\":\n            tokens.append((\"endif\", \"\"))\n        elif expr.startswith(\"repeat \"):\n            tokens.append((\"repeat\", expr[6:].strip()))\n        elif expr == \"endrepeat\":\n            tokens.append((\"endrepeat\", \"\"))\n        else:\n            tokens.append((\"var\", expr))\n        pos = m.end()\n    if pos < len(text):\n        tokens.append((\"text\", text[pos:]))\n    return tokens\n\n\ndef _collect(tokens, start, end_type, split_type):\n    depth = 0\n    body, alt = [], []\n    target = body\n    i = start\n    while i < len(tokens):\n        typ, val = tokens[i]\n        if typ in (\"if\", \"repeat\"):\n            depth += 1\n            target.append((typ, val))\n        elif typ in (\"endif\", \"endrepeat\"):\n            if depth == 0:\n                if typ != end_type:\n                    raise EndBlockError(f\"unexpected {typ!r}\")\n                return body, (alt if split_type else None), i + 1\n            depth -= 1\n            target.append((typ, val))\n        elif typ == \"else\" and depth == 0 and split_type:\n            target = alt\n        else:\n            target.append((typ, val))\n        i += 1\n    raise EndBlockError(\"unterminated template block\")\n\n\ndef _render(tokens, values) -> str:\n    out = []\n    i = 0\n    while i < len(tokens):\n        typ, val = tokens[i]\n        if typ == \"text\":\n            out.append(val)\n            i += 1\n        elif typ == \"var\":\n            out.append(_stringify(values.get(val, \"\")))\n            i += 1\n        elif typ == \"if\":\n            body, alt, i = _collect(tokens, i + 1, \"endif\", \"else\")\n            if _eval_expr(val, values):\n                out.append(_render(body, values))\n            elif alt is not None:\n                out.append(_render(alt, values))\n        elif typ == \"repeat\":\n            body, _, i = _collect(tokens, i + 1, \"endrepeat\", None)\n            count = int(float(_atom(val, values) or 0))\n            for _ in range(max(0, count)):\n                out.append(_render(body, values))\n        else:\n            i += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef evaluate_end_block(template: str, values: dict) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Evaluate the eject template with ``values`` (no printer parameter).\"\"\"\n    return _render(_tokenize(template), values)\n\n\ndef build_eject_values(max_layer_z: float, params: dict | None = None) -> dict:\n    values = dict(DEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS)\n    if params:\n        for key, value in params.items():\n            if key in values:\n                values[key] = value\n            elif key == \"max_layer_z\":\n                max_layer_z = value\n    values[\"max_layer_z\"] = max_layer_z\n    values[\"bed_heat_hold_ms\"] = int(round(float(values[\"bed_heat_hold\"]) * 1000))\n    values[\"bed_cool_hold_ms\"] = int(round(float(values[\"bed_cool_hold\"]) * 1000))\n    values[\"gantry_push\"] = float(max_layer_z) >= float(values[\"max_layer_z_threshold\"])\n    return values\n\n\ndef render_eject_block(template: str, max_layer_z: float, params: dict | None = None) -> str:\n    block = evaluate_end_block(template, build_eject_values(max_layer_z, params))\n    _check_no_placeholders(block)\n    return block\n\n\ndef build_end_block(template: str, max_layer_z: float, params: dict | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Build the concrete eject block for a part ``max_layer_z`` mm tall.\n\n    Thin, explicit alias of :func:`render_eject_block`: the API layer uses this\n    name for the ``check -> build_end_block -> slice_stl -> loop_3mf`` pipeline.\n    \"\"\"\n    return render_eject_block(template, max_layer_z, params)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# .gcode.3mf archive helpers\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef read_gcode_3mf(data: bytes) -> str:\n    with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(data)) as zf:\n        return zf.read(PLATE_GCODE).decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef _replace_plate(data: bytes, gcode: str) -> bytes:\n    payload = gcode.encode(\"utf-8\")\n    digest = hashlib.md5(payload).hexdigest().upper()\n    out = BytesIO()\n    with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(data)) as zin:\n        infos = zin.infolist()\n        raw = {info.filename: zin.read(info.filename) for info in infos}\n    names = {info.filename for info in infos}\n    with zipfile.ZipFile(out, \"w\", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:\n        for info in infos:\n            if info.filename == PLATE_GCODE:\n                zout.writestr(info, payload)\n            elif info.filename == PLATE_MD5:\n                zout.writestr(info, digest.encode(\"ascii\"))\n            else:\n                zout.writestr(info, raw[info.filename])\n        if PLATE_MD5 not in names:\n            zout.writestr(PLATE_MD5, digest.encode(\"ascii\"))\n    return out.getvalue()\n\n\ndef _check_no_placeholders(gcode: str) -> None:\n    for line in gcode.splitlines():\n        if line.lstrip().startswith(\";\"):\n            continue\n        if _TOKEN_RE.search(line):\n            raise PlaceholderError(f\"unevaluated placeholder in G-code: {line.strip()!r}\")\n\n\ndef _find_marker(text: str, marker: str, start: int = 0):\n    pattern = r\"^[^\\S\\n]*;?[^\\S\\n]*\" + re.escape(marker) + r\".*$\"\n    return re.search(pattern, text[start:], re.M)\n\n\ndef header_max_z(gcode: str) -> float:\n    m = re.search(r\"^;\\s*max_z_height:\\s*([0-9.]+)\", gcode, re.M)\n    if not m:\n        m = re.search(r\"max_z_height\\s*[=:]\\s*([0-9.]+)\", gcode)\n    if not m:\n        raise EndBlockError(\"max_z_height not found in file header\")\n    return float(m.group(1))\n\n\ndef replace_machine_end_span(gcode: str, block: str) -> str:\n    ex = _find_marker(gcode, \"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START\")\n    search_from = ex.end() if ex else 0\n    s = _find_marker(gcode, \"MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\", search_from)\n    if not s:\n        raise EndBlockError(\"MACHINE_END_GCODE_START not found\")\n    abs_s = search_from + s.start()\n    abs_s_end = search_from + s.end()\n    e = _find_marker(gcode, \"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\", abs_s_end)\n    if not e:\n        raise EndBlockError(\"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END not found\")\n    abs_e_end = abs_s_end + e.end()\n    return gcode[:abs_s] + block.strip(\"\\n\") + gcode[abs_e_end:]\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Public operations\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef inject_end_block(gcode_3mf_bytes: bytes, end_block_template: str,\n                     params: dict | None = None) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Replace the stock machine-end span in a pre-sliced .gcode.3mf.\"\"\"\n    gcode = read_gcode_3mf(gcode_3mf_bytes)\n    max_layer_z = header_max_z(gcode)\n    block = build_end_block(end_block_template, max_layer_z, params)\n    new_gcode = replace_machine_end_span(gcode, block)\n    _check_no_placeholders(new_gcode)\n    return _replace_plate(gcode_3mf_bytes, new_gcode)\n\n\ndef _profiles_dir(cli_path: Path) -> Path:\n    env = os.environ.get(\"BAMBU_PROFILES\")\n    if env:\n        return Path(env)\n    candidates = [\n        cli_path.parent / \"resources\" / \"profiles\",\n        cli_path.parent.parent / \"Resources\" / \"profiles\",\n        cli_path.parent / \"profiles\",\n        Path(\"/usr/share/BambuStudio/resources/profiles\"),\n        Path(\"/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/Resources/profiles\"),\n    ]\n    for candidate in candidates:\n        if candidate.exists():\n            return candidate\n    return candidates[0]\n\n\ndef _find_profile(profiles_dir: Path, name: str) -> dict:\n    for path in sorted(Path(profiles_dir).rglob(\"*.json\")):\n        try:\n            data = json.loads(path.read_text())\n        except (OSError, ValueError):\n            continue\n        if isinstance(data, dict) and (data.get(\"name\") == name or path.stem == name):\n            return data\n    raise SlicerUnavailable(f\"system profile {name!r} not found under {profiles_dir}\")\n\n\ndef _find_optional_profile(profiles_dir: Path, keywords) -> dict | None:\n    for path in sorted(Path(profiles_dir).rglob(\"*.json\")):\n        if not any(k in path.name.lower() or k in str(path.parent).lower() for k in keywords):\n            continue\n        try:\n            data = json.loads(path.read_text())\n        except (OSError, ValueError):\n            continue\n        if isinstance(data, dict):\n            return data\n    return None\n\n\ndef slice_stl(stl_bytes: bytes, end_block: str) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Slice ``stl_bytes`` with the stock A1 profile patched to ``end_block``.\n\n    The end block is injected by patching the machine profile JSON\n    (``machine_end_gcode``) -- never by shell arguments.\n    \"\"\"\n    cli = os.environ.get(\"BAMBU_CLI\")\n    if not cli:\n        raise SlicerUnavailable(\"BAMBU_CLI is not set; BambuStudio CLI is unavailable\")\n    cli_path = Path(cli)\n    if not cli_path.exists():\n        raise SlicerUnavailable(f\"BambuStudio CLI not found at {cli_path}\")\n\n    profiles_dir = _profiles_dir(cli_path)\n    machine = dict(_find_profile(profiles_dir, MACHINE_PROFILE_NAME))\n    machine[\"machine_end_gcode\"] = end_block\n    process = _find_optional_profile(profiles_dir, (\"process\",))\n    filament = _find_optional_profile(profiles_dir, (\"filament\",))\n\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        tmp = Path(tmp)\n        stl_path = tmp / \"input.stl\"\n        stl_path.write_bytes(stl_bytes)\n        machine_path = tmp / \"machine.json\"\n        machine_path.write_text(json.dumps(machine))\n        settings = str(machine_path)\n        if process is not None:\n            process_path = tmp / \"process.json\"\n            process_path.write_text(json.dumps(process))\n            settings = f\"{settings};{process_path}\"\n        out_path = tmp / \"plate_1.gcode.3mf\"\n\n        cmd = [str(cli_path), \"--load-settings\", settings, \"--slice\", \"0\",\n               \"--export-3mf\", str(out_path), str(stl_path)]\n        if filament is not None:\n            filament_path = tmp / \"filament.json\"\n            filament_path.write_text(json.dumps(filament))\n            cmd[3:3] = [\"--load-filaments\", str(filament_path)]\n\n        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)\n        if proc.returncode != 0:\n            raise SlicerUnavailable(\n                f\"BambuStudio CLI failed ({proc.returncode}): \"\n                f\"{(proc.stderr or proc.stdout).strip()}\"\n            )\n        if not out_path.exists():\n            candidates = sorted(tmp.glob(\"*.gcode.3mf\")) + sorted(tmp.glob(\"*.3mf\"))\n            if not candidates:\n                raise SlicerUnavailable(\"BambuStudio CLI produced no .gcode.3mf output\")\n            out_path = candidates[0]\n        data = out_path.read_bytes()\n\n    gcode = read_gcode_3mf(data)\n    _check_no_placeholders(gcode)\n    return _replace_plate(data, gcode)\n",
    "orca_plugin/_autoeject/stl.py": "\"\"\"Minimal, dependency-free STL parsing helpers.\n\nOnly what the A1 auto-eject checks and slicer need: bounding box, base\ncontact area and a couple of derived ratios.  Supports both binary and\nASCII STL.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport struct\nfrom typing import Iterable, Tuple\n\n\ndef _binary_triangles(data: bytes) -> Iterable[Tuple[Tuple[float, float, float], ...]]:\n    if len(data) < 84:\n        raise ValueError(\"not a valid STL (too short)\")\n    (count,) = struct.unpack_from(\"<I\", data, 80)\n    expected = 84 + count * 50\n    if len(data) < expected:\n        # Some exporters pad the header; fall back to whatever fits.\n        count = (len(data) - 84) // 50\n    off = 84\n    for _ in range(count):\n        vals = struct.unpack_from(\"<12f\", data, off)\n        # vals[0:3] normal, then 3 vertices of 3 floats\n        yield (\n            (vals[3], vals[4], vals[5]),\n            (vals[6], vals[7], vals[8]),\n            (vals[9], vals[10], vals[11]),\n        )\n        off += 50\n\n\ndef _ascii_triangles(data: bytes) -> Iterable[Tuple[Tuple[float, float, float], ...]]:\n    verts = []\n    for line in data.decode(\"utf-8\", \"ignore\").splitlines():\n        line = line.strip()\n        if not line.lower().startswith(\"vertex\"):\n            continue\n        parts = line.split()\n        if len(parts) < 4:\n            continue\n        verts.append(tuple(float(p) for p in parts[1:4]))\n        if len(verts) == 3:\n            yield tuple(verts)  # type: ignore[misc]\n            verts = []\n\n\ndef triangles(data: bytes) -> Iterable[Tuple[Tuple[float, float, float], ...]]:\n    \"\"\"Yield (v1, v2, v3) triangles from binary or ASCII STL bytes.\"\"\"\n    if not data:\n        raise ValueError(\"empty STL\")\n    head = data[:512].lstrip()\n    if head[:5].lower() == b\"solid\" and b\"facet\" in data[:2048].lower():\n        return _ascii_triangles(data)\n    return _binary_triangles(data)\n\n\ndef _cross(a, b, c):\n    ux, uy, uz = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]\n    vx, vy, vz = c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1], c[2] - a[2]\n    return (\n        uy * vz - uz * vy,\n        uz * vx - ux * vz,\n        ux * vy - uy * vx,\n    )\n\n\ndef bounds(data: bytes) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Return ``{min, max, size, center}`` for the STL.\"\"\"\n    tris = list(triangles(data))\n    if not tris:\n        raise ValueError(\"STL contains no triangles\")\n    xs, ys, zs = [], [], []\n    for tri in tris:\n        for v in tri:\n            xs.append(v[0])\n            ys.append(v[1])\n            zs.append(v[2])\n    mn = (min(xs), min(ys), min(zs))\n    mx = (max(xs), max(ys), max(zs))\n    return {\n        \"min\": mn,\n        \"max\": mx,\n        \"size\": (mx[0] - mn[0], mx[1] - mn[1], mx[2] - mn[2]),\n        \"center\": ((mn[0] + mx[0]) / 2.0, (mn[1] + mx[1]) / 2.0, (mn[2] + mx[2]) / 2.0),\n        \"triangles\": len(tris),\n    }\n\n\ndef base_contact_area(data: bytes, tol: float = 1e-3) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Sum of the X/Y area of triangles resting on the lowest Z plane.\"\"\"\n    tris = list(triangles(data))\n    if not tris:\n        return 0.0\n    zmin = min(v[2] for tri in tris for v in tri)\n    area = 0.0\n    for tri in tris:\n        if all(abs(v[2] - zmin) <= tol for v in tri):\n            n = _cross(*tri)\n            area += 0.5 * (n[0] ** 2 + n[1] ** 2 + n[2] ** 2) ** 0.5\n    return area\n\n\ndef write_binary_stl(path, triangles_data) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Small helper used by tests/fixtures to emit a binary STL.\"\"\"\n    with open(path, \"wb\") as fh:\n        fh.write(b\"\\x00\" * 80)\n        fh.write(struct.pack(\"<I\", len(triangles_data)))\n        for tri in triangles_data:\n            fh.write(struct.pack(\"<3f\", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0))\n            for v in tri:\n                fh.write(struct.pack(\"<3f\", *v))\n            fh.write(struct.pack(\"<H\", 0))\n",
    "orca_plugin/a1_end.gcode": "; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\n; AutoEject end block - Bambu Lab A1 (Factorian Designs method)\n; max_layer_z = {max_layer_z}\nG90\nG1 E-2 F1800\n{repeat cycle_count}\nM140 S{bed_heat_temp}\nM190 S{bed_heat_temp}\nG4 P{bed_heat_hold_ms}\nM140 S{bed_cool_temp}\nM190 S{bed_cool_temp}\nG4 P{bed_cool_hold_ms}\n{endrepeat}\n{if gantry_push}\n; gantry push at {gantry_push_z} mm\nG1 Z{gantry_push_z} F600\nG1 Y-0.5 F{push_feed}\n{else}\n; nozzle push fallback at {nozzle_push_z} mm\nG1 Z{nozzle_push_z} F600\nG1 Y-0.5 F{push_feed}\n{endif}\nG1 Y0 F{push_feed}\nM104 S0\nM140 S0\n; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\n",
    "orca_plugin/autoeject.py": "\"\"\"Signature adapter around the vendored v1 ``autoeject`` package.\n\nThe v2 ``SlicingPipeline`` hook hands the plugin a plain working G-code file\n(``ctx.gcode_path``), while v1 ``autoeject`` operates on ``.gcode.3mf`` bytes.\nThe v2 spec lists \"How to reconcile the autoeject function signatures using\ngcode_3mf_bytes with the documented ctx.gcode_path working G-code file\" as an\nopen question; this module answers it without reimplementing any eject rule or\nG-code generation:\n\n* :func:`build_end_block` accepts either the v2 form ``(params)`` or the v1\n  form ``(template, max_layer_z, params)`` and always delegates to the\n  vendored :func:`autoeject.slicer.build_end_block`.\n* :func:`inject_end_block` accepts plain G-code text *or* ``.gcode.3mf`` bytes.\n  For bytes it delegates to the vendored v1 implementation unchanged.  For\n  text it appends the block (or replaces the stock machine-end span when the\n  marker is present) using the vendored template renderer.\n* Everything else (``check``, ``loop_3mf``, ``read_gcode_3mf`` ...) is the\n  vendored v1 function re-exported verbatim.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport re\nimport zipfile\nfrom io import BytesIO\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom ._autoeject import (  # noqa: F401  (re-exported v1 API)\n    DEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS,\n    EndBlockError,\n    PlaceholderError,\n    SlicerUnavailable,\n    build_eject_values,\n    check,\n    evaluate_end_block,\n    loop_3mf,\n    parse_end_block,\n    read_gcode_3mf,\n    render_eject_block,\n    simulate_end_block,\n)\nfrom ._autoeject.slicer import (\n    build_end_block as _v1_build_end_block,\n    header_max_z as _v1_header_max_z,\n    inject_end_block as _v1_inject_end_block,\n)\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"DEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS\",\n    \"EndBlockError\",\n    \"PlaceholderError\",\n    \"SlicerUnavailable\",\n    \"build_eject_values\",\n    \"build_end_block\",\n    \"check\",\n    \"evaluate_end_block\",\n    \"inject_end_block\",\n    \"loop_3mf\",\n    \"parse_end_block\",\n    \"read_gcode_3mf\",\n    \"render_eject_block\",\n    \"simulate_end_block\",\n    \"wrap_gcode_text\",\n]\n\n# Bundled copy of ``profiles/a1_end.gcode`` so the folder installs into Orca\n# as-is, with no dependency on the web-app checkout.\nDEFAULT_END_BLOCK_TEMPLATE = Path(__file__).with_name(\"a1_end.gcode\").read_text()\n\n_PLATE_GCODE = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode\"\n_PLATE_MD5 = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5\"\n\n\ndef _max_layer_z(text: str) -> float:\n    \"\"\"``header_max_z`` with a max-Z-over-moves fallback for plain G-code.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return _v1_header_max_z(text)\n    except EndBlockError:\n        values = [float(m) for m in re.findall(r\"(?:^|\\s)Z(-?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\", text)]\n        return max(values) if values else 0.0\n\n\ndef build_end_block(params, max_layer_z=None, template=None):\n    \"\"\"Build the v1 eject block.\n\n    v2 form: ``build_end_block(params)`` (uses the bundled A1 template).\n    v1 form: ``build_end_block(template, max_layer_z, params)`` is passed\n    straight through to the vendored implementation.\n    \"\"\"\n    if isinstance(params, dict):\n        values = dict(params)\n        if max_layer_z is None:\n            max_layer_z = float(values.get(\"max_layer_z\", 50.0))\n        return _v1_build_end_block(template or DEFAULT_END_BLOCK_TEMPLATE,\n                                   max_layer_z, values)\n    return _v1_build_end_block(params, max_layer_z, template)\n\n\ndef inject_end_block(gcode, params=None, template=None):\n    \"\"\"Append the eject block to a working file (or inject into 3mf bytes).\n\n    ``gcode`` may be plain G-code ``str`` (the SlicingPipeline working file) or\n    ``.gcode.3mf`` ``bytes`` (the v1 fallback input).  The return type matches\n    the input type.\n    \"\"\"\n    tmpl = template or DEFAULT_END_BLOCK_TEMPLATE\n    if isinstance(gcode, (bytes, bytearray)):\n        return _v1_inject_end_block(bytes(gcode), tmpl, params)\n\n    text = gcode\n    block = build_end_block(params or {}, _max_layer_z(text), tmpl)\n    # v2 spec: append the eject block; there is no documented accessor for the\n    # printer's existing end G-code, so the stock span is left untouched.\n    return text.rstrip(\"\\n\") + \"\\n\" + block.strip(\"\\n\") + \"\\n\"\n\n\ndef wrap_gcode_text(gcode_text: str) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Wrap plain G-code text in a minimal in-memory ``.gcode.3mf`` archive.\"\"\"\n    payload = gcode_text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n    digest = hashlib.md5(payload).hexdigest().upper()\n    buf = BytesIO()\n    with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, \"w\", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:\n        zf.writestr(_PLATE_GCODE, payload)\n        zf.writestr(_PLATE_MD5, digest.encode(\"ascii\"))\n    return buf.getvalue()\n",
    "orca_plugin/plugin.py": "\"\"\"OrcaSlicer 2.5 ``SlicingPipeline`` plugin for the Bambu Lab A1 (A1 only).\n\nThe capability implements the single hook named by the v2 spec,\n``orca.slicing.SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase.execute``.  At\n``orca.slicing.Step.psGCodePostProcess`` it reads the working G-code file\n(``ctx.gcode_path``), delegates the eject decision entirely to the vendored\n``autoeject`` package and writes the file back in place.\n\nNo ``orca`` API is invented: only the plugin type, the ``execute`` hook and\nthe ``Step`` enum members named in the v2 spec are used.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\ntry:  # The real OrcaSlicer host module.\n    import orca  # noqa: F401\n    from orca.slicing import SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase, Step\nexcept ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - exercised by the fake module in tests\n    orca = None\n\n    class SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase:  # type: ignore[no-redef]\n        \"\"\"Fallback       "README.md": "# Bambu Lab A1 Auto-Eject\n\nA small web app for the **Bambu Lab A1 (256 x 256 mm bed, A1 only)**: upload one\npart, choose how many times it should print (N), and get back a native\n`.gcode.3mf` that prints the part N times, pushing each finished part off the bed\nbetween iterations (Factorian Designs method).\n\n* `autoeject/` - pure-Python core (STL checks, G-code end block, .gcode.3mf loop, motion sim).\n* `app/` - FastAPI app + single static page (`app/static/index.html`, no build step).\n* `profiles/a1_end.gcode` - the eject template (BambuStudio placeholders are evaluated before anything is written).\n* `fixtures/` - `cube.stl` and a real Bambu Studio A1 export `real_a1.gcode.3mf` (20.08 mm part, 72 layers).\n\n## API\n\n| Method | Path | In | Out |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| POST | `/api/check` | multipart STL (`file`) | JSON `{verdict, reasons, metrics}` |\n| POST | `/api/slice` | multipart STL (`file`), `n`, `bed_heat_temp`, `bed_heat_hold`, `bed_cool_temp`, `bed_cool_hold`, `cycle_count` | `.gcode.3mf` |\n| POST | `/api/fallback` | multipart `.gcode.3mf` (`file`), same eject params | `.gcode.3mf` |\n\nA `fail` verdict blocks the download (HTTP 400 with the reasons); `warn` is\nreported in the `X-Eject-Verdict` / `X-Eject-Reasons` response headers and never\nblocks. `X-Eject-Sim` carries the end-block simulation (boxes, path, collision /\nmissed-push flags) used by the browser preview. There is no printer parameter\nanywhere: the machine profile is always `Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle`.\n\n## Run locally\n\n```bash\n# 1. install (Python 3.13 + uv)\nuv sync\n\n# 2. run the app\nuv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000\n# open http://127.0.0.1:8000\n```\n\nSlicing uses the Bambu Studio CLI, so point the app at it:\n\n```bash\nexport BAMBU_CLI=/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/MacOS/BambuStudio\nexport BAMBU_PROFILES=/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/Resources/profiles\n```\n\n`/api/fallback` and `/api/check` work without the CLI; `/api/slice` answers\n`503` with a clear message when `BAMBU_CLI` is missing or not runnable.\n\n### Exporting a sliced file from Bambu Studio\n\nTo use the fallback path (recommended: slice in the GUI with your own A1\nsettings, then let the app swap the stock end block for the eject block):\n\n1. Open Bambu Studio, select the **Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle** printer, load your\n   part and slice it.\n2. Menu **File -> Export -> Export plate sliced file** (this writes a\n   `*.gcode.3mf`, not a plain `.gcode`).\n3. Upload that `.gcode.3mf` on the page, set N and the heat/cool params, and\n   download the patched file.\n\n### Tests\n\n```bash\nuv run pytest -q\n```\n\nThe tests never need a printer, the network, or the real Bambu Studio binary:\nthe slicer CLI is faked, and every module that reads or writes `.gcode.3mf` is\nexercised against `fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf`.\n\n## Deploy\n\n`railway.toml` starts `uv run --no-dev uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`\n(health check `/`). `Dockerfile` is provided for images where a pinned\nBambu Studio CLI is installed; set `BAMBU_CLI` / `BAMBU_PROFILES` accordingly.\n",
      "pyproject.toml": "[project]\nname = \"a1-eject\"\nversion = \"0.1.0\"\ndescription = \"Bambu Lab A1 N-loop auto-eject web app (Factorian Designs method)\"\nrequires-python = \">=3.13\"\ndependencies = [\n    \"fastapi>=0.115\",\n    \"uvicorn[standard]>=0.30\",\n    \"python-multipart>=0.0.9\",\n]\n\n[dependency-groups]\ndev = [\n    \"pytest>=8.0\",\n    \"httpx>=0.27\",\n]\n\n[build-system]\nrequires = [\"hatchling\"]\nbuild-backend = \"hatchling.build\"\n\n[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]\npackages = [\"autoeject\", \"app\"]\n\n[tool.pytest.ini_options]\ntestpaths = [\"tests\"]\naddopts = \"-q\"\n"
    }
  },

    "unified_diff": "--- a/README.md\n+++ b/README.md\n@@ -72,3 +72,84 @@\n `railway.toml` starts `uv run --no-dev uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`\n (health check `/`). `Dockerfile` is provided for images where a pinned\n Bambu Studio CLI is installed; set `BAMBU_CLI` / `BAMBU_PROFILES` accordingly.\n+\n+## OrcaSlicer plugin (v2)\n+\n+`orca_plugin/` is an OrcaSlicer 2.5 plugin of type `SlicingPipeline`. It appends\n+the same v1 eject block to the G-code OrcaSlicer exports for a **Bambu Lab A1**\n+(A1 only). It never reimplements eject logic: the v1 `autoeject` package is\n+vendored byte-for-byte under `orca_plugin/_autoeject/` and exposed as\n+`orca_plugin.autoeject`, with a thin signature adapter for the plain working\n+G-code file that the plugin hook provides.\n+\n+```\n+orca_plugin/\n+  __init__.py        # PEP 723 script header + [tool.orcaslicer.plugin] manifest\n+  plugin.py          # A1AutoEjectCapability (SlicingPipeline.execute + config UI)\n+  autoeject.py       # signature adapter over the vendored v1 package\n+  _autoeject/        # vendored v1 autoeject (unchanged)\n+  a1_end.gcode       # bundled copy of profiles/a1_end.gcode\n+```\n+\n+### Install\n+\n+Copy the whole `orca_plugin/` folder into OrcaSlicer's plugin directory and\n+restart OrcaSlicer.
